title: First and Last Claim Status per Prescription
prompt: Write a query that returns the first and last adjudication status for each prescription submitted to the PBM (pharmacy benefit manager). For each `prescription_id`, show the prescription ID, the earliest `adjudication_status` (by `submitted_at` timestamp), and the latest `adjudication_status`. A prescription may be submitted multiple times as it moves through re-adjudication; you need the status from the very first submission and the very last submission in the audit trail. If a prescription has only one submission record, the first and last status will be identical. Order results by `prescription_id` ascending.

composite_moves: window: FIRST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (PARTITION BY prescription_id ORDER BY submitted_at)
window: LAST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (PARTITION BY prescription_id ORDER BY submitted_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
DISTINCT to collapse partition rows to one row per prescription_id

hints: You need to look at all submissions for each prescription and pick the earliest and latest status values by timestamp.
FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE are window functions that can retrieve values from specific positions in a partition. Be careful with LAST_VALUE—the default frame only goes up to the current row.

Use FIRST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (PARTITION BY prescription_id ORDER BY submitted_at) for the earliest status, and LAST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (PARTITION BY prescription_id ORDER BY submitted_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) for the latest. Then SELECT DISTINCT to get one row per prescription.
answer_key:
SELECT DISTINCT
  prescription_id,
  FIRST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (
    PARTITION BY prescription_id
    ORDER BY submitted_at
  ) AS first_status,
  LAST_VALUE(adjudication_status) OVER (
    PARTITION BY prescription_id
    ORDER BY submitted_at
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS last_status
FROM pbm_adjudication_log
ORDER BY prescription_id;

_meta.scenario: a digital pharmacy tracking prescription submissions through PBM adjudication
